Platform upgrade handshake: the platform operator maintains
odh-<modulename>-config with data.platformVersion. After upgrade work
completes, the module echoes that version into status.releases as
name: "platform" so the platform can detect version alignment.

security_annotations.description: Action "actions/checkout" uses mutable ref "v6" instead of a SHA pin. A compromised action version can inject malicious code into the workflow.
ClusterRole uses default kubebuilder name "manager-role". When multiple operators are deployed, these generic names collide. Prefix with the operator name.
ClusterRole uses default kubebuilder name "metrics-auth-role". When multiple operators are deployed, these generic names collide. Prefix with the operator name.
ClusterRole uses default kubebuilder name "metrics-reader". When multiple operators are deployed, these generic names collide. Prefix with the operator name.
Role uses default kubebuilder name "leader-election-role". When multiple operators are deployed, these generic names collide. Prefix with the operator name.
ClusterRoleBinding uses default kubebuilder name "manager-rolebinding". Prefix with the operator name to avoid collisions.
ClusterRoleBinding uses default kubebuilder name "metrics-auth-rolebinding". Prefix with the operator name to avoid collisions.
RoleBinding uses default kubebuilder name "leader-election-rolebinding". Prefix with the operator name to avoid collisions.
